ComponentRef.description:
Which Component an object refers to: its UUID, after the Sheet Instance path that
leads to it. In v0.1 sheets are flat and the path is always empty.

path.description: The Sheet Instances from the top sheet down. Empty in v0.1.

ComponentType.description:
What kind of part a Part is: it decides what the Part needs and where it may be
placed, and gives the defaults for In BOM and In CPL, which are separate flags.

oneOf.description:
An ordinary part: it needs a Symbol and a Footprint, and reaches the board only
through Sync.

A part with a Symbol, a Footprint or both, such as a screw, a heat sink or a
mounting hole. It may be placed straight onto the board.

A deliberate short between Nets, made of touching Pads. It syncs like a Standard
part and is never Not Fitted.

ConnectionStyle.description: How a fill meets a Pad or Via.

oneOf.description: Through spokes across a clear ring, so the Pad solders easily.
The fill runs straight into it.
The fill keeps the gap clear and doesn't connect.

Corner.description: A corner of a Pad, in its own frame (+y up).

FieldText.description:
Where a field moved by hand sits: an offset from the Symbol origin in the Symbol's
own frame (so rotating or mirroring the Unit carries it along), and its text height
when it is not the default.

size.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

Fields.description: A Part's default fields, copied onto each Component placed from it.

custom.description: Free-form fields, such as `LCSC` or `DigiKey`, in the user's order.

FootprintCopyRow.description:
One copied Footprint: a `.redafp` file's keys in one row. The PCB file's part table
uses the same rows.

hash.description: The content hash of the Footprint, as copied.

provenance.description: Where the Footprint was imported from, as in a `.redafp` file.

FootprintGraphic.description: One shape a Footprint draws on a non-copper Layer.

fill.description: Whether a closed shape is filled.

FootprintLayer.description: The Layers a Footprint draws on besides copper.

height.description: The part's greatest height above the board, when known.

FootprintText.description: One field text of a Footprint, on a Silkscreen or Assembly Layer.

at.description: The text centre, relative to the Footprint origin.

field.description:
The field it shows: `Designator`, `Value` or any field name. A field the Component
does not have draws nothing.

rotation.description: An angle in integer millidegrees, counter-clockwise. Serialises as a bare integer.

anyOf.description:
Two positive lengths. Which side runs across follows the [`Orientation`], so
`{"width": 200 mm, "height": 300 mm}` landscape is 300 mm wide.

height.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

width.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

FrameSize.description:
A sheet's paper: a standard size, written as its name (`"a4"`), or a custom one,
written as `{"width": …, "height": …}`.

Hole.description:
A drilled hole: round when `width == height`, otherwise a slot along the longer side.
Sizes are the finished diameter.

height.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

rotation.description: Turns a slot in the Pad's frame, counter-clockwise.

tolerance.description:
The allowed deviation from the finished size. Stored and shown; it changes no
geometry.

width.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

HoleTolerance.description: How far a finished hole may come out larger (`plus`) or smaller (`minus`).

minus.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

plus.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

InsideEdge.description: A Pin decoration just inside the body edge.

oneOf.description: A clock input's wedge.

Justify.description:
One of the nine anchor points of a text block: its corners, the middles of its sides
and its centre. Top is the first line's capital height, bottom the last line's
baseline, and middle halfway between them.

expansion.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

NetLabel.description:
A named marker that joins the Wire (or Pin) under `at` to every other Net Label with the
same name on its sheet.

rotation.description: Counter-clockwise; only how the label is drawn.

NoConnect.description: A mark on the Pin under `at` stating that it is deliberately left unconnected.

Orientation.description: Which way up a sheet's paper is.

oneOf.description: The longer side runs across.
The longer side runs up.

OutsideEdge.description: A Pin decoration just outside the body edge.

oneOf.description: An inversion circle.
The active-low input flag.
The active-low output flag.

Pad.description: A copper area, with or without a hole, of a Footprint.

at.description:
The Pad's anchor, relative to the Footprint origin: the hole sits there, Tracks
connect there and the Pad turns about it.

chamfer_ratio.description: How deep the chamfers of a `chamfered_rect` are.

corner_ratio.description:
How round the corners of a `rounded_rect`, or the uncut corners of a
`chamfered_rect`, are.

corners.description:
Which corners are rounded (`rounded_rect`) or chamfered (`chamfered_rect`), in the
Pad's frame. Left out, all four.

height.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

hole.description: A round hole when width equals height, otherwise a slot. SMD Pads have none.

mask.description: Per-side solder-mask expansion or tenting; omitted values inherit the board's rule.

offset.description: Where the copper sits relative to `at`, in the Pad's frame. Left out, on it.

paste.description: An SMD Pad's paste opening; omitted, it inherits the board's rule.

rotation.description: An angle in integer millidegrees, counter-clockwise. Serialises as a bare integer.

side.description:
The side of an SMD Pad, in the Footprint's frame. Left out, the top. Pads with a
hole have none: their copper is on every Layer.

width.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

zone_connection.description: How Zone fills of its Net join it. Each value left out inherits.

oneOf.description: A rectangle with rounded corners: `corner_ratio`, on `corners`.

A rectangle with `corners` cut off by `chamfer_ratio`, the others rounded by
`corner_ratio`. An octagon is one.

PartEntryRow.description: One part-table entry: a `.redapart` and a `.redasym` file's keys in one row.

copies.description: The sheet's Footprint copy of each alternate, in the same order.

footprints.description: The alternate Footprints by Library UUID, the default first.

hash.description: The content hash of the Part with its Symbol and Footprints, as copied.

provenance.description: Where the Part was imported from, as in a `.redapart` file.

symbol_provenance.description: Where the Symbol was imported from, as in a `.redasym` file.

uuid.description: The entry's own UUID, which Units point at.

in_bom.description: Whether its Components go into the BOM, by default.

in_cpl.description: Whether its Components go into the CPL, by default.

symbol.description: The Symbol by UUID. Mechanical Parts may have none.

expansion.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

corner_ratio.description: Thousandths of a percent of half the shorter side: 100000 is fully round.

height.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

width.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

Pin.description: A connection point of a Symbol.

at.description: The connection end of the Pin, relative to the Symbol origin.

description.description: What the Pin is for, shown on hover. Left out when empty.

inside_edge.description: The glyph drawn just inside the body edge, such as a clock wedge.

length.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

name_visible.description: Whether the Pin's name is drawn.

number.description:
Unique across the Symbol; Pins map to the Pads with the same number unless the
Part overrides it.

number_visible.description: Whether the Pin's number is drawn.

outside_edge.description: The glyph drawn just outside the body edge, such as an inversion dot.

rotation.description: The direction from the connection end towards the body, counter-clockwise from +x.

PinMap.description:
The Part's exceptions to the implicit map, where a Pin connects to the Pads with its
own number.

pins.description: Pins mapped to other Pads, or to several, sorted by Pin number.

unconnected.description: Pad numbers deliberately left unconnected, sorted.

PinPads.description: One Pin mapped to an explicit set of Pads.

PinType.description: A Pin's electrical type, which ERC checks.

Point.description: A position on a Schematic Sheet or the PCB Document, which share one coordinate type.

x.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

y.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

Port.description:
A named, directional marker that joins the Wire (or Pin) under `at` to every Port of
the same name on any Schematic Sheet of the Project.

hide_cross_reference.description: Hides the Port's cross-reference note, when the Project shows them.

rotation.description: Counter-clockwise; only how the Port is drawn.

PortDirection.description:
Which way a Port's signal flows. It only changes how the Port is drawn and checked;
every direction connects the same way.

PowerPort.description:
A named symbol, such as GND or 3V3, that joins the Wire (or Pin) under `at` to the
Project-wide Net of that name on every Schematic Sheet.

hide_name.description: Draws the symbol without its name. The name still joins the Net.

rotation.description: Counter-clockwise; only how the symbol is drawn.

PowerPortStyle.description: The fixed, built-in look of a Power Port.

oneOf.description: A horizontal bar, for positive rails.
Three shrinking bars.
A downward triangle.
Ground bars with diagonal strokes.

Provenance.description:
Where an imported Library element came from, kept with the element so its terms travel
with it: vendor parts stay under the vendor's terms after import.

copyright.description: Copyright lines found in the imported files, kept verbatim.

service.description: The service the files came from, such as `SnapMagic`, or `Unknown`.

terms_url.description: The service's terms of use, when known.

Shape.description: A drawn shape. Lines, arcs and outlines are stroked with the graphic's width.

oneOf.description: An axis-aligned rectangle between two opposite corners.

The arc from `start` around `center`, sweeping `sweep` counter-clockwise (negative
is clockwise).

sweep.description: An angle in integer millidegrees, counter-clockwise. Serialises as a bare integer.

radius.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

oneOf.description: A closed polygon through its corners.

rotation.description: An angle in integer millidegrees, counter-clockwise. Serialises as a bare integer.

SheetFrame.description:
A sheet's frame settings. A sheet has at most one; with none it uses
[`SheetFrame::defaults`].

border_zones.description:
The Border Zones along the frame, on by default. Their counts are derived from the
paper ([`BorderZones::for_paper`]), never stored.

drawing_number.description: The sheet's drawing number; empty by default.

revision.description: The sheet's own revision. Empty, the title block shows the Project's.

title_block.description: The built-in title block, on by default.

SheetGraphic.description: A free line or rectangle drawn on a sheet. It has no electrical meaning.

oneOf.description: A straight line, at any angle.
An axis-aligned rectangle between two opposite corners.

SheetSize.description: A standard paper size. Its dimensions are given landscape; [`Orientation`] turns it.

SheetText.description: Free text drawn on a sheet. It has no electrical meaning.

at.description: The anchor point, which [`SheetText::justify`] places on the text block.

justify.description: Which of the block's nine points sits on `at`; `bottom_left` by default.

text.description: The text; `\n` starts a new line.

Side.description: Which face of the board a sided Layer is on.

SymbolGraphic.description: One shape of a Symbol Unit's body.

fill.description: Whether a closed shape is filled.

unit.description: The Unit it is drawn on.

designator_prefix.description: The Designator prefix of Components placed from it, such as `R` or `U`.

TextStyle.description: How a Footprint text is drawn.

font.description:
The font family, such as `Hershey Roman Simplex` or `Noto Sans`. A family missing
on this machine draws as Noto Sans.

thickness.description: The pen width of stroke-font text; outline fonts are filled and ignore it.

Unit.description: One independently placeable section of a Symbol.

name.description: Such as `A`, or `Power` for a power section.

UnitInstance.description:
One placed Unit of a Component. Every Unit of a Component carries the same copy of the
Component's data; Commands keep the copies equal.

at.description: Where the Symbol origin sits on the sheet.

designator_locked.description: Locked against Re-annotate, which then leaves the Designator as it is.

field_text.description:
The fields moved by hand on this Unit, one entry per field, sorted by field name
(the names of `visible_fields`). A field with no entry is autopositioned. Each
Unit has its own.

footprint.description: The chosen Footprint: the UUID of one of the Part's alternates, if it has any.

in_bom.description: Whether the Component goes into the BOM; copied from the Part, then editable.

in_cpl.description: Whether the Component goes into the CPL; copied from the Part, then editable.

locked_fields.description:
The Locked Fields, by name: Update from Library leaves them as they are, though
they can still be edited by hand. Every Unit of a Component carries the same set.

mirror.description: Mirrored left to right before rotating.

part.description: The part-table entry on this sheet it was placed from.

rotation.description: An angle in integer millidegrees, counter-clockwise. Serialises as a bare integer.

visible_fields.description:
The fields drawn on the sheet, by name: `designator`, a built-in field's stored name
(such as `value`) or a free-form field's name. Designator and value by default.

Waiver.description:
A recorded acceptance that one Violation is intentional, so checks stop reporting it.

It is stored in the Document that holds the objects involved, and matches a Violation
of the same check whose objects are exactly these, in any order. Once those objects no
longer break the check together, it matches nothing.

author.description: Preference `user.name` at the instant this Waiver was created.

check.description: The check id of the waived Violation, such as `unconnected_pin` or `clearance`.

created.description: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch, UTC, from the injected Clock.

objects.description: The UUIDs of the objects involved, sorted.

reason.description: Why it is waived. Left out when empty.

Wire.description:
A Wire: a polyline at any angle through its `vertices`, in order, at least two. It
connects where an end touches a Pin's connection point or any point of another Wire,
and anywhere along it that it passes over a Pin's connection point, a Port, a Power
Port or a Net Label. Two Wires crossing mid-span never connect.

ZoneConnection.description:
How a Zone fill joins a Pad of its own Net. Each value left out inherits from the
`zone_connection` rule.

angle.description: 0, 45 or 90 degrees in the Pad's frame.

gap.description: The clear ring around a relieved or unconnected Pad.

spoke_width.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

footprints.description: The copied Footprints the part table's entries share, sorted by UUID.

format.description: The file-format version. REDA writes only the current one.

frame.description: The sheet's frame settings. Without it the sheet is A4.

graphics.description: The free lines and rectangles, sorted by UUID.

net_labels.description: The Net Labels, sorted by UUID.

no_connects.description: The No-Connect Markers, sorted by UUID.

parts.description: The part table: one copied Part with its Symbol per entry, sorted by UUID.

ports.description: The Ports, which join Nets across sheets, sorted by UUID.

power_ports.description: The Power Ports, which join Nets across the Project, sorted by UUID.

sheet.description: The sheet's identity; it matches the sheet's entry in the Project file.

texts.description: The free texts, sorted by UUID.

units.description: The placed Units, sorted by UUID.

waivers.description: The Waivers of ERC Violations whose objects are on this sheet, sorted by UUID.

wires.description: The Wires: one orthogonal segment each, sorted by UUID.
